The '''Zambarti''' were lavender-hued [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with wide bodies and huge heads. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were shaped like saucers, and their hair resembled a slate-colored bird's nest. Their large ears were pink in coloration, and looked like wings. Members of this [[Species/Legends|species]] had more than one heart.<ref name="AoCI" /> [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji]] was a member of this species.
